welcome.title: Welcome to the Universal Brothers Admin Panel
welcome.description: Sign in to the admin panel and see what this training covers.

dashboard.title: Understanding the Dashboard
dashboard.description: What the numbers, cards and shortcuts on the dashboard mean.

navigation.title: Finding Hajj Package Management
navigation.description: The menu, the Hajj package list, its search and filters, and where settings and help live.

new-package.title: Creating a New Hajj Package
new-package.description: Open the package builder and understand its 14 steps, checklist and help panels.

basic-information.title: Adding Basic Package Information
basic-information.description: Title, package code, tier, series, short description, days and Hajj year.

package-settings.title: Configuring Hajj Package Settings
package-settings.description: Arrival city, shifting or non-shifting, and Aziziya.

package-options.title: Creating Package A and Package B
package-options.description: Hotel options: when to use them and how to name Option A and Option B.

hotels.title: Adding Hotels and Accommodation
hotels.description: Pick saved hotels for each option and for every option, set nights, and fill the Aziziya card.

room-types.title: Adding Room Types and Prices
room-types.description: Add Quad, Triple and Double room types inside each option's box.

prices.title: Entering PKR, SAR and USD Prices
prices.description: Type each price exactly as the brochure prints it, and check the price summary.

itinerary.title: Building the Complete Itinerary
itinerary.description: Copy the approved 14-day journey plan, check English and Islamic dates, and add transport on a travel day.

mashaer.title: Adding Mina, Arafat and Muzdalifah Details
mashaer.description: Fill the Mina and Arafat cards from saved arrangements and understand the shared-information warning.

transport-meals.title: Configuring Transport and Meals
transport-meals.description: Add saved transport lines, including paid extras, and set meal plans for the hotels.

inclusions.title: Managing Included Services
inclusions.description: Fill "Included in this package" by copying the approved list, and see how duplicates are prevented.

exclusions.title: Managing Excluded Services
exclusions.description: Add the saved "Not included" lines customers pay for separately.

upgrades.title: Adding Optional Upgrades
upgrades.description: Add the Kaaba-view supplement and tent upgrades customers can choose at extra cost.

notes.title: Adding Reusable Notes and Policies
notes.description: Saved notes, a package-specific note, and private internal admin notes.

images.title: Uploading Package Images
images.description: Upload the main photo and a gallery photo with a description.

seo.title: Adding SEO Information
seo.description: The title and description Google shows, and the web address.

review.title: Reviewing the Complete Package
review.description: Use Step 13 to read the whole package, the checklist and any warnings before customers see it.

save-draft.title: Saving the Package as a Draft
save-draft.description: Save without publishing, and find the draft again with Continue.

preview.title: Previewing the Package
preview.description: See the draft exactly as a visitor would, before it is live.

validation.title: Fixing Validation Warnings
validation.description: What happens when something required is missing, and how the messages take you to the fix.

publish.title: Publishing the Package
publish.description: Put the package on the website from Step 14.

public-page.title: Viewing the Public Package Page
public-page.description: Open the live page and check what customers see — and what they never see.

edit-package.title: Editing an Existing Package
edit-package.description: Find a live package, make a change and save it safely.

duplicate.title: Duplicating a Package Safely
duplicate.description: Make a draft copy of a package without touching the original.

final-checklist.title: Final Checklist and Best Practices
final-checklist.description: The printable package checklist and the habits that keep the website correct.

reusable-information.title: Using Reusable Information
reusable-information.description: Hotels, transport, notes and more saved once — and how to change them safely.

templates.title: Using Package Templates
templates.description: Start a new package from a template, and save a package as a template.
